text:
sophia: quick ping — runtime onboarding guide link in the curl auth example is dead according to the nightly scan.
link-scan-bot: scan result: 1 external 404 -> https://gov.example/old-auth (404) found in docs/runtime/onboarding.md around line 118
maria: can you paste the exact path? i'll take a look if it's just swapping to an archived url.
sophia: docs/runtime/onboarding.md — users reported hitting 404 when following the example during customer onboarding calls.
samir: reproduced locally. external page removed. options: 1) rehost snippet in our KB and change link to docs.redwood.ai/snapshots/…, 2) point to archive.org, or 3) vendor PR if vendor still hosts elsewhere.
maria: prefer rehost + a clear note that it's a snapshot. also add owners metadata so future scans ping the right person.
samir: i put up a micro-PR to rehost the sample and update the curl example: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4389 — swaps to /snapshots/gov-auth and removes the `--insecure` flag per security nits.
docs-bot: deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-4389--docs.redwood.ai/ — preview expires in 7d
jack: small suggestion: replace `--insecure` with `--cacert /path/to/ca.pem` and mention TLS version. we don't want examples encouraging insecure defaults.
samir: good call — updated example to use `--cacert` and added a footnote about verifying cert chains.
maria: LGTM, left an approval and added a line in the PR description asking to add `owners: ["maria"]` to the doc frontmatter in a follow-up so scan alerts route properly.
sophia: thanks. two ask items: 1) can someone add a one-line changelog blurb we can paste to #support so they can handle user queries, and 2) if docs-custodians want to adopt long term we should reassign ownership after this patch.
maria: i'll add the owners field in a follow-up PR and can take custodianship if needed.
samir: merging once CI green. i'll ping #support with the blurb after deploy.
sophia: appreciated — thanks all :tada:
